notes.title: Ver. 1.0.51 Changelog
notes.content:
Heyo, no long time now see.
Just updated the game with some minor changes, nothing special.

Here are the changes:
Tutorial/Factory/Dungeon/Void Stage small nerfs (mostly some spikes removed)
Mushroom Bossbar fixed
Spikeboss Phase 2 skip fixed
Finalboss nerfed (hp nerf and attack nerfs)
Speedrun Achievement Time increased (was 1 hour and 15 minutes before, nows its 1 hour and 30 minutes)
Minor Changes and some visual fixes

Thanks for playing and feel free to contact me if you found something weird or just wanna write.
Cya. :)

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.5 Changelog
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
Fixed Forest Screens 2 and 3 Room Transition
Fixed Propeller Enemy Wind Bug (sometimes the wind was still active although enemy was defeated)
Fixed Deathcounter after boss (sometimes it didn't showed up at all)
Fixed friends stucking in the ground at the intro.
Fixed bossorbs going over other savefiles (hopefully, thx lennygold!)
